rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MODERNIZATION OF THE HEALTH CARE DELIVERY SYSTEM, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: \"Health Care Delivery Modernization Act of 2001.\" This bill principally seeks: (1)  To modernize the health care delivery by adopting a comprehensive, consistent and systematic approach to health issues and concerns to complement the state-of-the-art technology; and (2) To further enhance local autonomy by granting local government units full powers in the formulation of policies and by mandating the Department of Health (DOH) to perform tasks relative to the operation and maintenance of hospitals and public health services under its supervision and control.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE CONCURRENCE OF THE SANGGUNIANG PANLALAWIGAN OR PANLUNGSOD, AS THE CASE MAY BE, FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF TERMINALS, OUTLETS OR AUTHORIZED AGENTS OF ANY GAME OF CHANCE
rows.title_short: Requiring the Concurrence of Sanguniang Panlalawigan or Panlunsod for the Establishment of Game of Chance Terminals
rows.abstract: This bill states that NO lotto terminal, jai-alai off fronton station, bingo outlet or any authorized agent of any game of chance shall be established in any part of the province or city without the concurrence of the sangguniang panlalawigan or sangguniang panlungsod, as the case may be, of the local government unit concerned. Any person found guilty of violating the provisions of this Act shall suffer the penalty of not exceeding one (1) year, and a fine of fifty thousand pesos (P50,000.00) at the discretion of the court.

rows.abstract: "Racketeer-Infl uenced and Corrupt Organization (RICO) Act of 2001"> The purpose of this measure which is patterned after the RICO (Racketeers Influenced and Corrupt Organization) statute of the United States is primarily aimed at preventing the useof money and power by organized crime syndicates to subvert and corrupt legitimate business by facilitating the prosecution of and imposing stiffer penalties for criminal offenders. rows.title_full: AN ACT ADOPTING THE GROSS INCOME TAXATION FOR CORPORATIONS AND INDIVIDUALS ENGAGE IN TRADE OR BUSINESS AND/OR PRACTICE OF PROFESSION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PERTINENT PROVISIONS OF TITLE II OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: This bill proposes a GROSS INCOME APPROACH in taxing the business income derived by individuals and corporations. Rationale:  By shifting to gross income taxation, the areas of discretion are minimized. Tax examiners need to validate only the accuracy of the taxpayer's declared gross sales/receipts and "cost of goods sold" or "cost of sales/services" .  It would lessen paper work  of both the taxpayer and tax examiner as substantiation requirements will be significantly reduced. As it will be easier to comply with, more taxpayers will be encouraged to file their returns.  And with more taxpayers in the tax net, tax collection will consequently increase.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2001-07-24

rows.title_full: AN ACT PRIORITIZING THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE GARMENT AND TEXTILE INDUSTRY IN THE COUNTRYSIDE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 823, AS AMENDED, AND EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 952
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to give the garment manufacturers in the regions outside the capital region priority in the distribution of the export quota to decongest the national capital region. The mandate should be that NO quotas be granted to the capital region unless and until the request for "bids" from the other regions are granted, on annual basis, to the extent of their historical peak capacities. It becomes imperative that the membership of the GTE Board must be EXPANDED to include the private stake players in the industry.

rows.abstract: "Juvenile Justice Act of 2001"> This bill intends to provide a just and more humane system of treating juvenile offenders in society through a comprehensive and integrated approach toward rehabilitating the delinquency. In consonance with the provisions of the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child and the UN Standard Minimum Rules for the Administration of Juvenile Systems, this bill pursues an effort at emphasizing on the need of rehabilitating and reintegrating the juvenile offender into the mainstream of society as in contrast to the traditional-med ieval approach of stressing solely on the punitive aspect of the offender's delinquent act.

Also included are programs for continuous education and training and adequate salary and benefits. This proposed Magna Carta of the Philippine National Police attempts to properly address the existingloophol es and inadequacies of the present system and laws governing the PNP structure, organization and operation. rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING THE CRIME OF ABUSE OF WOMEN IN INTIMATE RELATIONSHIPS, PRESCRIBING PENALTIES THEREFOR, PROVIDING FOR PROTECTIVE MEASURES FOR VICTIMS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale:  To date, there is still NO specific forms of violence against women. They occur within the family or household, in the workplace, in educational institutions, in churches, or in the general community. Some form of violence against womenare already addressed by legislation. To  date, however, there is still NO specific legislation that appropriately addresses violence against women in intimate relationships. The experience of legal servicing NGOs like the Women's Legal Bureau, Inc.shows that existing legisation is either inadequate or inappropriate to address this kind of abuse and the distinct needs of the women victims.  In many cases, there is no available remedy that can be used. This bill seeks to address this gap.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05516
